{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Filter to completed orders
completed = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
